insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results. This change starts in API version 2026-10. The API will explicitly indicate when a metafield is not configured for filtering.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should ensure that metafields are properly configured for filtering before querying them. This change affects any app using the GraphQL Admin API to query metafields, so developers should review their code and adjust as necessary to avoid errors. The change is backwards compatible for API versions prior to 2026-10, but it's crucial to adapt to the new behavior for future compatibility.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will experience more accurate and reliable data from apps that use the GraphQL Admin API, as apps will no longer receive silently incorrect results due to misconfigured metafields.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the reliability and accuracy of data retrieved through the GraphQL Admin API, reducing the likelihood of apps providing incorrect information to merchants due to misconfigured metafields.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { namespace: "my_namespace", key: "my_key" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including Order, Collection, and metafield changes, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages, as part of the Liquid July ’26 developer preview.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.5.2, which includes fixes for theme commands and bumps the Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, which may affect apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to version 13.0.2, which includes non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags and the ability to bypass confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a new requirement for unique app names, to reduce merchant confusion over identical app names.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API now supports the @inContext directive with an optional channelId argument, allowing for more flexible querying.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes fields for productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle, providing more detailed information.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API now includes discount allocations for bundle components, allowing for more accurate calculations.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Webhooks, and Liquid templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring accurate results. Additionally, new metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to changes on various objects like Product, Order, and Customer.

themes.title: Improved Development Tools
themes.detail: Liquid templates have been updated to support composing pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page development. Furthermore, full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, reducing the need for external libraries and data warehouses.
